items.title: BYD installed 10,000 hyper-fast 1,500kW chargers in just 5 months
items.summary: BYD announced that it has already installed 10,000 of its 1.5 megawatt “flash charging” stations, despite only starting earlier this year. The number puts it halfway to its lofty goal of 20,000 stations by year’s end – and just about on pace to hit it.
items.titleZh: 比亚迪在短短5个月内安装了10000个超高速1500kW充电器
items.summaryZh: 比亚迪宣布，尽管今年早些时候才开始，但它已经安装了1万个1.5兆瓦的“闪光充电”站。这一数字使其在年底前达到20000个车站的崇高目标的一半，并且几乎可以实现这一目标。
